authorisation_status: NOT_GRANTED at the time of writing - the architect authorises execution internally after reviewing this readiness bundle

architect_decision.what: adapt the hardened J9R1 runner to the J11 actor, and to that actor ONLY
architect_decision.operational_lineage: August V26 imitation -> J2 35D -> J11 -> this qualification
architect_decision.july_status: METHODOLOGY AND EVIDENCE ONLY; no July checkpoint, dataset or label is an input
architect_decision.not_reopened: this preregistration implements that decision and proposes no alternative

what_this_stage_is: six declared cells, one matrix, one leaf: three DETERMINISTIC starts and three STOCHASTIC_HELD repeats at the nominal start, 500 steps each, run sequentially A to F
what_this_stage_is_not: not a fit and not an optimizer step
not a critic and not PPO
not a promotion and not a deployability claim
not a retry of J9R1: the ACTOR is different
no new threshold of any kind

actor.clock_state: EXACTLY zero in every 35-wide input layer, direct and alias
actor.sigma_source: the actor's OWN frozen log-std head: pi.1.weight[2:] is exactly zero and pi.1.bias[2:] = -5.2983174324035645, so exp gives 0.005. This stage REFUSES to edit a log-std head and never injects a sigma constant into the action.
actor.leaf_validity_precondition: the J11 leaf is consumed ONLY if its own commit_verification.json declares pass true, it carries no TECHNICAL_INVALID marker, and no stale lock or staging directory survives beside it. An unverified leaf is not evidence and its actor is not loadable here.
actor.manifest_must_describe_itself: the J11 manifest must name the module_state.pkl beside it and carry the matching actor_digest. J8 shipped a manifest naming its PARENT's module; that defect must not be inherited by trusting it here.

matrix.order_is_frozen: A, B, C, D, E, F, sequential
matrix.fail_fast_rule: a behavioural FAIL in one cell is PRESERVED and every later cell still runs. Only a TECHNICAL or INTEGRITY exception stops the matrix, and then nothing is committed.
matrix.identical_to_j9r1: this matrix is value-identical to the frozen v26c_j9r1_closed_loop.MATRIX, cell for cell, in id, mode, seed and offset. verify_scientific_equivalence proves it field by field before any environment is constructed.
matrix.offset_unit: SECONDS of episode start time, RELATIVE to cfg.t_start
matrix.offsets_are_the_config_choices: the three offsets are exactly the episode_start_offset_choices_s of the pinned resolved training config

action_semantics.deterministic: module.forward_inference, then the deterministic action, cross-checked bit-for-bit against rollout_eval's own deterministic path every step
action_semantics.stochastic_held: rollout_eval._held_stochastic_action: action = mean + std * unit, where std is exp(logits) read off the LIVE head and unit is exploration_noise.HeldStandardNormal(default_rng(seed), shape, 1). No sigma constant is ever multiplied into the action.
per_step_assertions: forward_exploration and forward_inference agree on mean and std
action_semantics.clipping: DIAGNOSTIC, never binding, exactly as in J9R1

gates.source: v26c_j1_collect.J1_GATE for every non-penetration criterion, v26c_j3_closed_loop.J3_KINEMATIC_GATE unchanged, and the penetration contract's 0.028 band as the SOLE binding penetration bar
gates.proven_by: verify_scientific_equivalence compares every constant field by field against the FROZEN v26c_j9r1_closed_loop module, and re-derives the common gate from J1_GATE and the kinematic gate from J3_KINEMATIC_GATE at source
gates.penetration_bar_removed_from_the_common_: J1_GATE's max_penetration_m_max of 0.020 is DROPPED, exactly as J9R1 drops it: the sole binding penetration criterion is the contract's 0.028 band

kinematic_semantics.ankle_min: ankle_min <= -0.03 rad; more negative PASSES, exactly -0.03 PASSES
kinematic_semantics.knee_strictly_flexed: every knee sample strictly < 0.0; exactly 0.0 FAILS
kinematic_semantics.within_bounds: knee in [-1.5, 0.0] and ankle in [-0.7, 0.7], inclusive on both ends

telemetry_integrity.status: a SEPARATE fail-closed TECHNICAL invariant, never a behavioural criterion
telemetry_integrity.on_failure: the cell is technically INVALID - a statement about the evidence, never the gait

gates.aggregate_rule: PASS iff 6/6 behavioural PASS AND 6/6 telemetry-valid

penetration.no_other_threshold: no penetration threshold is written down in the runner itself

per_cell_visibility: the three penetration bands with counts and fractions
the full gate checks and what failed

wait_hs.resolved_by: name, from the LIVE RUNTIME actor feature names, never a hard-coded index
wait_hs.why_surfaced: J9R1 cell B failed with the FSM held in WAIT_HS for every step and zero valid cycles. J10R1 collected the missing rows and J11 fitted on them. Counting WAIT_HS per cell is the fastest read on whether that failure mode recurred.
wait_hs.why_not_binding: this stage reuses J9R1's criteria exactly and invents none. Attaching a threshold to WAIT_HS would be a NEW gate, and a new gate must be preregistered as such, not smuggled in under an adaptation.

diagnostics_exclusion_note: valid_cycle_count is DELIBERATELY absent from this list: it is a BINDING check, and listing its measure among the non-binding diagnostics would be self-contradictory. J9R1 listed it; that is corrected here without touching any threshold.

reset_check.semantics: osim_trj_cmc_like._initialise_episode: max_start = max(cfg.t_start, cfg.t_end - episode_duration); requested = cfg.t_start + max(0.0, episode_start_offset_s); episode_start = min(requested, max_start); self.t = episode_start
reset_check.tolerance_justification: the comparison is an exact arithmetic identity; 1e-9 s is a cross-platform float-representation allowance, not a behavioural tolerance
reset_check.t_start_and_t_end_read_live: cfg.t_start and cfg.t_end come from the model setup XML and are read from the LIVE environment, never hard-coded

recording.count_is_exact_not_a_lower_bound: J9R1 accepted any non-empty directory; 18 would mean a writer failed silently and 20 that something else wrote there. J10R1 hardened this and J12 inherits it.

future_leaf.write_protocol: atomic commit, no-clobber, under an exclusive sibling lock taken with O_CREAT|O_EXCL: sibling staging, receipt, leaf re-check, rename, THEN post-commit verification
future_leaf.validity_is_conditional: the committed leaf is VALID EVIDENCE if and only if commit_verification.json exists inside it and declares pass true. The leaf is born carrying a TECHNICAL_INVALID marker, committed by the rename itself and removed only after the verification passes.
future_leaf.j9r1_had_no_post_commit_verification: J9R1 recorded its receipt hash after the rename and compared it to nothing; J12 adopts the J10R1/J11 protocol
future_leaf.paths_are_leaf_relative: J9R1 recorded a REPO-relative STAGING path for sim_outputs, which ceased to exist at the commit. Corrected here.
future_leaf.outcome_fail_still_commits: a behavioural FAIL still commits the full evidence and exits nonzero

preflight.inert: no torch, no ray, no OpenSim; no environment constructed, reset or stepped; no write
preflight.proved_not_asserted: heavy modules are measured in sys.modules before and after, and any module introduced by the preflight is a BLOCKER; the sentinel output root's existence is measured before and after and must never be created

pinned_runtime_sources_note: rollout_eval.py authenticates BOTH action paths - the deterministic parity reference and _held_stochastic_action. exploration_noise.py authenticates the held-noise sequence for seeds 123, 124 and 125, so a change there would silently change cells D, E and F. osim_trj_cmc_like.py authenticates the transcribed reset semantics. env_factory.py builds the environment. The resolved config carries the three offsets and the runtime literals. asymmetric_rl_module.py is pinned because it DEFINES the class that class_and_ctor_args.pkl names and that the checkpoint loader deserialises. J9R1 never pinned it; a change there would change the network that is rolled out.

module_load_contract.silent_failure_mode: ray's checkpoint loader catches EVERY exception while unpickling class_and_ctor_args.pkl and falls back to a bare RLModule with no weights, returning it WITHOUT raising. A stage that does not check would roll out an empty network in complete silence.
measured_not_assumed: the loaded module's class name equals AsymmetricActorCriticTorchRLModule
get_state() is non-empty and holds exactly the ten actor keys
every loaded tensor is bit-identical to the pinned module_state.pkl
module_load_contract.found_by: an independent read-only audit of this readiness bundle
